The effect of skill 'accidental damage' is adjusted to: when using the 'Coltsaa' to attack enemies, it deals (1/2/3/4/5/...) points of damage to all enemies adjacent to the target.

notes.title: V0.9.2.5 Update Announcement - Ye Kai/Xiao Yao Enhanced
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you to all the players for your support. Although the game's popularity is not high and sales have not met expectations (mainly due to issues with the art style and user experience), our game continues to receive positive reviews. We will continue to update the content for everyone and make the game better and better! We will also address the issue of art style by adding new skins and modifying some old standing paintings. Please rest assured!!!

In addition, the official update roadmap for the V1.0 version of the game has been displayed on the game store page~!

The first major patch of  VineCard one week after its launch is as follows:


1. Balance adjustment.

Ye Kai has added a new skill [example not false]:

When equipped with the Fallen Leaf Flying Blade, if no attack is made, the weapon's attack power will increase by 1 at the end of the turn.

https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/de329fc9acd68ff5a2351f99cfac00fabaa0111b.png

Explanation: When we initially designed the character Ye Kai, we intended to make it a rhythmic and consumptive character because the reference character prototype was Comrade Ye Kai from Gu Long's novel. Compared to Li Xunhuan, his flying sword was more casual and unrestrained, but not as deadly. Therefore, we gave the character a certain level of damage growth and explosive ability. But the data feedback within a week shows that the character's current strength is weak, mainly due to weak growth in the later stage,

We have decided to add back the skills that were initially discarded, such as' not inflated ', allowing players to achieve high explosive levels in the later stages through positional strategies.

Xiao Yao - Little Beggar Skill [My Cloth Clothes] Adjustment

At the end of each round, all armor will be converted into attack power and will become ineffective after the next attack.

https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/45ea7addc59a7745865437dfe112a56968fdd784.png

Original effect:

At the end of each round, all armor will be converted into attack power and will become ineffective after the next action.

explain:

We have noticed that the beggar is the character with the lowest clearance rate, and the core issue is that it is difficult to control the burst time of my cloth clothes. We have decided to strengthen this skill to allow players to more easily deal explosive damage. After all, this character's growth is slow, the output range is small, and resources are all hit one stick at a time, requiring a strong post burst.

2. New station options [Fengmang Casting]

Effect: Increases the attack power of the current weapon by 6 points

https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/a32a9de552bf5dd175cc27d5bb82171726744efb.jpg

Explanation: After adding 'Immortal Casting' in the previous version, we found that this type of skill has a qualitative improvement on many weapons, such as' Golden Bell Shield ',' Gatling ',' Salted Fish Stick ', etc. Although the options for station weapons are usually not the first choice for players (mainly because players are not good at utilizing weapon resources during the early stages), we have decided to add some powerful skills to the weapon buff genre.


3 new difficulty levels - Shura mode (added to the Steam leaderboard) is expected to debut in the next version, welcome all kinds of experts to challenge!

The rules are as follows:

【1】 Random character winning streak challenge

【2】 Based on the difficulty of the difficult mode, but suffered fatigue damage after 250 steps

【3】 Join the Steam global player's highest winning streak ranking

notes.title: V0.9.1.8 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Optimized Mo Yu's puppet summoning mechanism:

When killing enemies with theft skills, if the number of puppets does not reach the limit, priority will still be given to summoning puppets.

2. Optimized the refresh mechanism for mocking enemies, such as' Crow ', who will not appear directly near the player's location when the map is refreshed.

3. Optimized the reward pool for items in various levels of treasure chests, ensuring that most dropped items can bring direct gains or rare weapons with special effects.

Of course, we still retain some combinations that are difficult to directly generate gains, but may occasionally occur, such as picking up sharpening geese while holding Gatling. We believe that the low probability of unexpected items being released from treasure chests is still a part of the player experience, but we will continue to monitor and optimize for drops that have received negative feedback!
